title: 客户销售Top5
query: 只查询 askdata_mock：统计2026年8月实付金额合计最高的5个客户，返回客户名称和实付金额合计，不额外筛选订单状态。
reason: 结果数值和维度匹配（忽略别名、列顺序、行顺序）

result.sql: SELECT customers.customer_name AS "客户名称", SUM(orders_current.paid_amount) AS "实付金额合计" FROM orders_current JOIN customers ON orders_current.customer_id = customers.customer_id WHERE orders_current.order_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-01' AND DATE '2026-08-31' GROUP BY customers.customer_id, customers.customer_name ORDER BY "实付金额合计" DESC LIMIT 5
result.analysis: 查询结果返回了5个客户的名称及实付金额合计。其中安澜科技以1631402.41最高，远景集团以1060739.97位列第二。
